tasks.description: Read canonical routine soil-check history for one saved plant and distinguish it from watering and first aid.
constraints: Return a valid unified Git patch with exact current context and separate headers in JSON. Controller applies and tests. Scope backend-independent repository/read model and focused tests. No UI, transport, schema, model migration or unrelated changes.

Offer owner-bound routine history for a saved plant through CollectionRepository. Reuse LocalStore's private RoutineUndoTask and CatalogueCareJournalEntry. Require an ordinary routine task with valid rule UUID, action check_soil, condition check_soil_first and exact occurrence_key lowercase rule UUID + ':' + due local day. Exclude first aid, watering, other plants/owners, tombstones and unlinked entries. Active entry must be pointed to by completed task and link back. Keep genuinely voided routine entries visible after the same task is re-completed and its latest completion points elsewhere. Return id, taskId, local day and state (or canUndo) with stable newest-first ordering; no duplicate display. Validate owner/session and cancellation, cohere in one canonical read. Reuse the strengthened routine identity in undo validation and adapt only routine-undo synthetic occurrence keys as needed.
Add focused CollectionWireTests for active, voided, recompleted, unrelated action, arbitrary occurrence and wrong owner/plant. Avoid any UI work or fixture network. Parent tasks stay open.

acceptance_criteria.description: Scoped diff and Swift gate verify real owner-bound history classification with no regressions.
